<!-- ── How it works ───────────────────────────────────────── -->
<div class="mv-section">

    <div class="mv-how-text">
      <h2 class="mv-section-heading">How OpenSpace visualizes missions</h2>
      <p class="mv-prose">Every mission is positioned correctly in the solar system using archived trajectory data. Every flyby happens at the moment it really did. Every image appears where the spacecraft was when it captured it — with the actual instrument footprint and pointing direction.</p>
      <p class="mv-prose">Mission visualizations sync with OpenSpace's time controls, so you can play forward at any rate, rewind, or scrub to any specific moment. Combined with Globe Browsing, you can fly with a spacecraft to a planet and continue down to its surface — one continuous experience, one application.</p>

      </div>
      <div class="mv-cap">
        <h3 class="mv-cap-title">Real trajectory data</h3>
        <p class="mv-cap-desc">SPICE kernels from NASA and ESA place every spacecraft at its exact position for any given date and time.</p>

        <p class="mv-cap-desc">Camera fields of view, observation targets, and acquired images appear at the moment and position they were captured.</p>
      </div>
    </div>

<div class="mv-section">
  <div class="impact-cta-card">
    <h2>Start flying with spacecraft</h2>

<script>
(function () {
  var missions = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.mv-mission'));

  missions.forEach(function (mission) {
    var panel = mission.querySelector('.mv-panel');
    if (!panel) return;

    panel.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var isOpen = mission.classList.contains('is-open');

      missions.forEach(function (m) {
        m.classList.remove('is-open');
        var p = m.querySelector('.mv-panel');
        if (p) p.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });

      if (!isOpen) {
        mission.classList.add('is-open');
        panel.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });

    panel.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
        e.preventDefault();
        panel.click();
      }
    });
  });
})();
</script>
